text: Its originals carry a 0.1% base edge, refunded as instant rakeback while you are within a daily zero-edge allowance. After that a 0.1% edge applies, and a few games use a bet-size-based edge on very large bets.
Its blog says all its originals run at 100% RTP, with rakeback on the first $5k wagered each day (post updated May 2026). Its help centre says around 99%, with zero edge on the first $50,000 wagered.
Many of its originals run around 99% RTP, roughly a 1% edge, and the exact figure varies by game and risk setting.
